newsitem.title: DENMARK: Copenhagen Airport opens new cargo centre.
newsitem.headline: Copenhagen Airport opens new cargo centre.

text.p: Copenhagen International Airport said on Tuesday it opened a new freight customs centre as part of its strategy to become a major air traffic and cargo hub in northern Europe.
"The new centre will take care of imports and exports for major parts of northern Europe dealing with all types of air freight," Copenhagen Airports said in a statement.

It said the new freight customs centre was only a small part of the current expansion programme for Copenhagen International Airport, with over 200 million crowns invested in new cargo terminals and freight areas.
In 1998 a new 500 million crown SAS Cargo Centre is to open at Copenhagen Airport.
